form_fields.name: server_url
form_fields.label: URL
form_fields.description: etcd Prometheus 指标地址，填写完整 URL
form_fields.guide_short: 填写完整的 http:// 或 https:// 指标 URL，例如 http://127.0.0.1:2379/metrics；页面没有拆分的协议、主机、端口或路径字段。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Enter the complete http:// or https:// metrics URL, for example http://127.0.0.1:2379/metrics. The page has no separate scheme, host, port, or path fields.

form_fields.name: tls_ca
form_fields.label: CA证书路径
form_fields.description: HTTPS 访问时使用的 CA 证书路径
form_fields.guide_short: HTTPS 场景下填写采集节点上用于校验服务端证书的 CA 文件路径；HTTP 场景留空。
form_fields.guide_short_en: For HTTPS, enter the path on the collector node to the CA file used to verify the server certificate. Leave it empty for HTTP.

form_fields.name: tls_cert
form_fields.label: 客户端证书路径
form_fields.description: HTTPS 双向认证时使用的客户端证书路径
form_fields.guide_short: 仅 mTLS 场景填写采集节点上的客户端证书路径，并与客户端密钥成对配置。
form_fields.guide_short_en: For mutual TLS only, enter the client certificate path on the collector node and configure it together with the client key.

form_fields.name: tls_key
form_fields.label: 客户端密钥路径
form_fields.description: HTTPS 双向认证时使用的客户端密钥路径
form_fields.guide_short: 仅 mTLS 场景填写与客户端证书配套的私钥路径，并限制采集进程之外的文件读取权限。
form_fields.guide_short_en: For mutual TLS only, enter the private-key path paired with the client certificate and restrict file read access outside the collector process.

form_fields.name: interval
form_fields.label: 间隔
form_fields.description: 监控数据的采集时间间隔（单位：秒）
form_fields.guide_short: Telegraf 拉取 etcd 指标的周期，单位秒，默认 60，页面最小值为 1。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Telegraf interval for pulling etcd metrics, in seconds; the default is 60 and the page minimum is 1.

form_fields.name: insecure_skip_verify
form_fields.label: 跳过证书校验
form_fields.description: HTTPS 场景下是否跳过服务端证书校验
form_fields.guide_short: 开启后不校验 HTTPS 服务端证书；默认关闭，生产环境应保持关闭并配置可信 CA。
form_fields.guide_short_en: When enabled, HTTPS server certificates are not verified. It is off by default; keep it off in production and configure a trusted CA.
